verses.28:42: وَأَتۡبَعۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةࣰۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَقۡبُوحِينَ

meaning: The root قبح (qbH) describes something as bad, ugly, or abominable. It also refers to God removing someone far from good or prosperity, or rendering them foul.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
